articles.author: The Associated Press
articles.title: Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured - NPR
articles.description: The European climate service Copernicus said the Earth just sweltered through its hottest month on record in August. Scientists said the heat surge is mostly due to human-caused climate change.
articles.content: WASHINGTON Earth cooked to its hottest month on record in August, blowing far past a key climate threshold, due to the dangerous double whammy of human-caused climate change and a supersized El Nino,… [+5450 chars]
